task_name: arXiv Attention Is All You Need
instruction: Using only the visible arXiv search interface, select the arXiv identifier field if it is available, enter 1706.03762, and submit the search. Open the result titled Attention Is All You Need. On its abstract page, report the complete visible author list, the original submission date, and the primary subject classification. You must perform the field selection when available, query entry, submission, and result opening through the UI; do not navigate directly to a known abstract URL or answer from prior knowledge.
